Because this act is a 1948 nationalization decree and the corpus shows the reference only from the original enactment, the dangling link is most likely a corpus/history artefact rather than a live legal gap in the original law. Under Slovak/CS legislative technique, later repeal of a referenced provision does not retroactively void the original reference unless the amended text expressly reuses it after the repeal.
